queries.sql: SELECT s.status_name, COALESCE(COUNT(t.id), 0) AS ticket_count FROM (SELECT 'Open' AS status_name UNION SELECT 'Closed' UNION SELECT 'Reject by IT' UNION SELECT 'Done') AS s LEFT JOIN helpdesk_tickets t ON s.status_name = t.status GROUP BY s.status_name

SELECT DATE(ticket_date) as date, COUNT(id) as ticket_count FROM `helpdesk_tickets` WHERE ((MONTH(ticket_date) = 09 AND YEAR(ticket_date) = 2025) OR (MONTH(ticket_date) = 10 AND YEAR(ticket_date) = 2025)) GROUP BY DATE(ticket_date) ORDER BY DATE(ticket_date) ASC
SELECT YEAR(ticket_date) as year, COUNT(id) as ticket_count FROM `helpdesk_tickets` GROUP BY YEAR(ticket_date)

SELECT `helpdesk_tickets`.`pic_id`, MONTH(ticket_date) as month, COUNT(helpdesk_tickets.id) as ticket_count, IFNULL(pics.name, "Unknown") as pic_name FROM `helpdesk_tickets` LEFT JOIN `pics` ON `helpdesk_tickets`.`pic_id` = `pics`.`id` GROUP BY `helpdesk_tickets`.`pic_id`, MONTH(ticket_date)
SELECT HOUR(ticket_date) as hour, COUNT(id) as ticket_count FROM `helpdesk_tickets` GROUP BY HOUR(ticket_date) ORDER BY `hour` ASC
SELECT DATE(ticket_date) as ticket_date, COUNT(id) as ticket_count FROM `helpdesk_tickets` GROUP BY DATE(ticket_date) ORDER BY `ticket_date` ASC
